title: Christian D NDE 4662
content: I woke up in some scrub hearing friends' voices looking for me. I called to them and told them I was bleeding to death and because of the distance from a hospital told them to ring the rescue helicopter, which they did. An ambulance arrived and I was loaded into it so they could take me to where the chopper could land. At this point, I felt it was time to slip into a state of meditation and self-check what other damage my body may have. I add here that I have sustained many serious accidents and have been thought to have been dead by rescuers before so am quite calm at such times. As I drifted off I could hear a friend who was in the ambulance with me start panicking to the ambulance driver that he better get in here as I was dying and unresponsive. My friend's partner had to drive the ambulance to the chopper landing area while the medics attended to me. I only remember hearing my friend and the medic's voices briefly. Then, I will try to explain as best I can, I was surrounded by love, warmth, light and felt happier than I ever have before or since. Everything and all that is good was in this light. In the light was a seemingly uncountable crowd of people who are my ancestors and relatives that have left here over the ages and are now there. I recognized the ones who have been here in my time here and at the front were also my dogs from throughout my time here. I felt absolutely that they were family that I had known forever and were there to bring me home. I don't remember speaking but instead all questions were answered before they were asked. There was discussion by some that it wasn't time yet as there was still something I had to come back here for and then I can come home. Wish I knew what it is because now I feel lost and don't want to be here. What is called 'life' here is nothing but pain sadness and emptiness for me yet I know I have to wait to go and must not end this existence at my own hand (bummer). There are other things that were told to me that I will never tell so the next thing I knew I was in the rescue chopper heading to hospital. On arrival, the trauma team asked to take photos for teaching, as it was the best facial lacerations on a living person they had seen. My skull was visible where my nose and face had been and they said I had to come to grips with the loss of vision in my left eye. I have restored that eyes vision to better than 20/20 now but am still trying to heal my hips and back that I smashed and which ache terribly twenty-four hours a day seven days a week. In previous accidents I have been told I would lose my legs but have healed them also to nearly a hundred percent so maybe I am here to learn about how painful this place is and how much it takes before you just give up.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: It "wasn't time yet" and there was "still something I had to come back here for" before he could "come home."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe facial lacerations and other injuries; bleeding heavily and becoming unresponsive in an ambulance en route to a rescue helicopter.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Included a "seemingly uncountable crowd" of ancestors/relatives and his dogs; and being told it was not time yet.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel described; directly into being "surrounded by love, warmth, light" with relatives/ancestors and then back in the rescue chopper.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Presence of deceased dogs at the front of the group, described as family who had known him forever and were there to bring him home.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was surrounded by love, warmth, light and felt happier than I ever have before or since.”
